title: fix clippy warnings
description: take a look at all clippy warnings for sutra. organze and triage them.
implementation_plan: Fix 63 mechanical clippy warnings across 22 files. Allow 8 design-judgment warnings (too_many_arguments, type_complexity, large_enum_variant). Wave 1: never_loop error + single-instance lints. Wave 2: collapsible_if (41 instances).
execution_record: Fixed 64 mechanical clippy warnings and added #[allow] for 8 design-judgment warnings across 22 files. Bulk was collapsible_if (43 instances) using let-chains. The one deny-level error (never_loop in python.rs) was a for-loop-with-break pattern that should have been if-let-next. Three warnings survived the first pass: a collapsible_if inside the never_loop fix, a collapsible_if inside the map_entry fix, and the type_complexity allow placed on the parameter instead of the function.
